notes:
I found two places a family could turn up to, but I couldn't confirm either one's hours for September 4 to 6, 2027. That weekend is Saturday to Monday, and Monday is Labour Day. I ran out of searches before I could check the zoo, aquariums or playgrounds, so none of those are included. I also left out the Canada Science and Technology Museum. I only found its hours on third-party sites, not on the museum's own page, and those sites disagreed about whether it opens on Mondays.

Notes for the parent:
- The Children's Museum is in Gatineau, Quebec. Their page describes it as minutes from downtown Ottawa, inside the Museum of History. 
General admission tickets include access to the Museum of History and the Canadian Children's Museum.
 
During busy times, access to the Children's Museum is on a first-come, first-served basis.

- The Museum of Nature's own pages did not give a price or an age band, so I left those out. 
Admission to the permanent galleries is free on Thursdays from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m.
 That doesn't fall on the visit dates.
